title: ADD PANES in the window FRAME. p-rotation along the golden spiral.

do_not_reinvent.frame: /data/klein-bifocals.json  one frame. two prescriptions already. do not swap the glass.
do_not_reinvent.crack: /data/rustdesk-browser-static.json  the rustDesk?browser crack stays STATIC. panes are NOT in that crack.
do_not_reinvent.rate: /data/pi-rate-set.json + js/pi-budget.js  p is the budget. F already meters. do not mint a third constant.
do_not_reinvent.spin: /data/gyroscope-fold.json  rotation already sits. this is the path of the panes, not a second gyro.

panes.where: IN the frame of the window. muntins. segments of the one glass.
panes.not: a third window. not a widget in the rustDesk crack. not a new browser.
panes.yes: more than two looks can sit as panes on the same frame. bifocals stay the hinge.

spiral.ratio: f. golden. each pane is f of the last.
spiral.rotation: p. each step turns p along that spiral. the remainder is the unique seat.
spiral.along: the spiral is the path. p is the turn. f is the grow. one walk.

law: panes live in the frame. they turn p on a f spiral. the crack stays empty. A stays the cup.
pull: cut panes in the chrome. walk them f. turn them p. do not fill the static gap.
